text:
elena: Heads-up — deploy bot just flagged a release-notes mismatch for v3.12.0 during the midnight window. Release notes mention the new routing flag (`--smart-route`), but the image we pushed doesn't contain the flag handler. 

sanjay: Wait what, how did that slip through? I reviewed the changelog PR.

elena: PR had the docs commit but the runtime change got reverted in a cherrypick conflict. Looks like release notes were updated after the revert.

deploy-bot: Automated safety check failed: release_notes_changed_without_binary (rule_id: RN-047). Suggested action: hold rollout + rollback to v3.11.5 or pause and hotfix.

ops-brian: @elena can you confirm if behavior is breaking? Any user-facing errors so far?

elena: No customer-facing errors reported yet, but internal QA saw a 502 from the router when `--smart-route` was referenced in startup config. Stack trace: `Error: unknown option 'smart-route'`.

liz: Suggestion: pause rollout, pin traffic to current variant, and cut a 3.12.1 hotpatch with the runtime handler re-applied. That keeps the version semantics and avoids a full revert.

kevin: If we hotpatch, we need to update release notes and make sure docs and SDKs line up. Also need legal/support blurb.

support-amy: I'll draft a short customer note ready to send if anything spins up. For now I can monitor alerts and update the incident channel.

sanjay: I'm leaning hotpatch too. Revert would be cleaner but will require a follow-up forward fix. Hotpatch keeps continuity for telemetry and metrics.

ops-brian: Deploy-bot suggests rollback as one option. What's the operational impact of hotpatch vs rollback?

elena: Hotpatch path: create branch from v3.12.0 tag, reapply the handler commit, bump to v3.12.1, build, smoke test in staging, promote. Time estimate ~50-70 minutes.

ops-brian: Rollback path: traffic-pin to v3.11.5 and run a rollback operation, then cut a new release later. Time estimate ~15-25 minutes for rollback, but double work later.

deploy-bot: Note: auto-rollback threshold would trigger if p95 error rate > 2x baseline for 10m. Current metrics: p95 error rate +10% but noisy. No automatic abort yet.

liz: Given metrics are noisy and no wide customer impact, hotpatch + pin the remainder of rollout feels right. We'll also enable a kill-switch: `route.weight(v3.12.1)=0` if any regression appears.

kevin: OK. Ops: please pause the staged rollout. @ops-brian can you run `deployctl pause --release v3.12.0` and pin traffic to v3.11.5 while we build the hotpatch?

ops-brian: Running: `deployctl pause --release v3.12.0` — paused. Pin command: `deployctl traffic pin --from v3.12.0 --to v3.11.5 --percent 100` — in progress.

ops-brian: Pin applied. All new traffic now routed to v3.11.5. :white_check_mark:

elena: I'm starting the branch for 3.12.1 now and bringing the handler back. Will notify when staging build is up.

support-amy: I'll prepare a short internal comm for CSMs: "Minor release note mismatch identified; rollout paused; no customer impact observed; hotpatch in progress."

kevin: Good. Legal wants a changelog diff in the PR description before we ship. Make sure the PR links the original changelog commit + revert.

liz: Agreed. Sanity checklist before promote: unit tests green, staging smoke (basic request flow + config parsing), perf quickcheck.

elena: Staging build succeeded. Smoke test shows no startup errors. P95 latency unchanged.

ops-brian: Ready for promote when you say the PR is merged.

elena: Merged and tag pushed: v3.12.1. Building prod image and will kick the rollout at low ramp with deploy bot.

deploy-bot: New release v3.12.1 detected. Initiating staged rollout according to policy "standard-night-window". Will monitor error-rate and p95.

kevin: I updated release notes and PR description with the revert context and legal-approved blurb.

support-amy: Internal note posted to #support-ops. CSMs on watch.

deploy-bot: Staged rollout at 5%: metrics healthy. Continuing ramp to 25% in 10m.

elena: Keeping this thread for final confirmation, then we'll close. Thanks everyone for quick turnaround. :heart:

sanjay: Great work. Postmortem: add an automated check to gate changelog updates that reference new flags to ensure binary matches release notes (RN-047 -> RN-048).

kevin: Filing the follow-up ticket now.

elena: Closing thread once deploy reaches 100% stable.

deploy-bot: Rollout completed: 100% v3.12.1. No regressions detected in 30m window. Marking release as stable. :tada:
